## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the preview hands `pageType` exactly as `PageView` does

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T09:07Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/SourcePageEditor.tsx` (`previewSchema`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: Studio in objectui.

- **Why p3:** a source page's preview draws with the wrong width and no title, but the running app is right. The contract broken is "preview is runtime" (builder-ui.md §6).
- **Direction:** one shared builder for the `{ type, pageType }` pair, used by `PageView` and the preview, so the two writers cannot drift again.
- **Pins:** an `app` and a `home` source page preview with the title and the page width. Control: a `record` page is unchanged.

Claim: PM loop round 5
Session: `session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`
Account: `os-bill`
Branch: `claude/issue-11933-preview-page-type`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11933`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface (on `f3a0488`):
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/SourcePageEditor.tsx`: `previewSchema` (about `:153`) hands `pageType` exactly as `PageView` does.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`: only the `{ type, pageType }` mapping (about `:150`–`:190`). It moves into one shared module-private builder that both writers call, so they cannot drift, as triage directs.
- At most one new module-private helper beside either file. It is not exported from the package entry.
- The tests beside these, and `.changeset/11933-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- `PageRenderer` and the spec's page schema;
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `interfaceCreate.tsx`, which this seat's re-land of objectui#11932 holds;
- any new export from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry;
- `packages/components/src/ui/**` and `packages/i18n/**`.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over these paths: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell Studio page preview: a source page's live preview drops the page's type, so an app or home page previews as a record page with no title and record width, while the running app draws both | PageView's own type-to-pageType mapping is the runtime reference | every Studio author previewing an app or home page`
Thread-read: 6056545683
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **In-flight claims read 2026-10-08T10:24Z:** none names `SourcePageEditor.tsx` or `PageView.tsx`.
- **Open objectui PRs, read 2026-10-08T10:24Z:** none touches either file.

Why `Clause-②: no`: an internal helper shared by two app-shell modules. No export, prop, spec key or `packages/i18n` key changes.
